method: Complete named explanatory fields from the exact subject/pointer. Original summaries, subjects and historical reviews unchanged. This is an excerpt, not a standalone replacement contract or review.

summary.answer: Builds the start-menu WZ team scoreboard and footer with backgrounds and a fake QuitButton. Footer follows the nested scoreboard model; menu_loaded binds the fake button to the menu buttonModel. It selects WZTeamScoreboard as default focus, installs the existing close hook, optionally calls PostLoadFunc and returns self. Scoring and scoreboard data producers are not implemented here.

Public-reuse investigation is inherited from frozen archived-record-00026; this author performed no outside research.

summary.answer: Initializes scoreboard and CodCaster models and activeTab only if unset, then builds team scoreboard/map/inventory. PC visibility predicates require input mode, scoreboard/force conditions and activeTab; nonmouse Visible/ForceVisible use their explicit bit/model tests. SetState switches inventory-open state, focus and cleanup, including multi-item-pickup/cursor helpers. Model/input subscriptions update presentation. Gameplay inventory changes and original native UI lifetime are not proved by these visibility calls.
